full_prompt_en: A square fantasy seascape painting shows a blue coastal city and a dark sailing ship beneath vast storm clouds. The upper two-thirds of the frame are filled with deep ultramarine and teal cloud masses, broken near the upper center by a pale electric-blue opening. The cloud shapes curl and sweep diagonally toward a burst of orange fire near the middle-right horizon. On the left, a cluster of pale stone towers and domes rises above the water. The tallest tower has a rounded blue dome and narrow spire, while smaller domed forms step downward toward the center. A line of dark palms stands along the low shore at the far left. In front of the city, the land becomes a rough rocky bank that runs across the lower edge into a dark choppy sea. Near the right center, a sailing vessel sits in silhouette, its pointed bow turned inward and several masts or rigging lines visible against the glowing haze. A few much smaller dark marks suggest distant craft across the water. Orange firelight flickers behind the city and beside the ship, throwing narrow gold reflections across the waves. Most of the architecture and shore remain cool blue, their edges softened by mist and painterly strokes. The sky's bright opening gives a secondary turquoise glow, while the horizon fire provides a warm opposing focal point. The surface is visibly brushed and textured, with loose cloud edges and small rough marks in the sea. The overall composition is expansive and ominous, balancing pale vertical towers on the left against a dark vessel and firelit haze on the right.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻海景绘画呈现一座蓝色海滨城市和一艘深色帆船，上方是巨大的风暴云。上部三分之二由深群青与青蓝云团填满，上部中央附近裂开一处浅电蓝色光口。云形翻卷，并斜向中右地平线的一团橙色火光。左侧，浅石色塔楼与圆顶群升出水面。最高塔楼有圆润蓝顶和细尖塔，其余较小圆顶向中央阶梯般降低。最左侧低岸上立着一列深色棕榈树。城市前方，陆地变为粗糙岩岸，沿下缘伸入深色、起伏的海水。中央偏右，一艘帆船呈剪影，尖船首向画内转，几根桅杆和索具线在发亮雾气前可见。水面上更小的深色痕迹暗示远船。橙色火光在城市后和船旁闪动，把狭窄金色倒影投向波浪。大部分建筑与岸边仍是冷蓝色，边缘被雾气和绘画笔触软化。天空亮口提供第二种青蓝光，地平线火焰则成为相对的暖色焦点。表面可见笔刷与肌理，云缘松动，海面布满粗小痕迹。整体构图开阔而不祥，以左侧浅色竖向塔楼平衡右侧深色船只与火光雾气。
style_prompt_en: The fantasy painting sets electric turquoise and deep ultramarine against a compact orange-gold glow. Broad swirling color masses dominate the upper area, while low dark textured strokes anchor the bottom. Cool silhouettes soften into mist, allowing a few pale vertical accents to remain legible without rigid outlining. Warm light gathers near one horizon point and breaks into small reflections across a darker surface; a second cool opening lights the upper field. Loose, layered brushwork gives clouds a turbulent sense of movement and nearer texture a rough tactile edge. Distant forms are compressed by blue atmospheric haze, while a few sharp lines provide scale and direction. The composition uses an expansive dark field and two unequal light sources to create visual tension. The overall effect is dramatic, otherworldly, and moody, with color contrast carrying more force than fine detail.
style_prompt_zh: 奇幻绘画把电光青蓝与深群青放在集中的橙金色光晕前。宽阔翻卷色团主导上部，低矮深色纹理笔触稳住下缘。冷色剪影软化进雾气，使少量浅色竖向重音无需僵硬勾线仍可辨。暖光聚在地平线某处，并碎成较暗表面上的细小倒影；另一处冷色开口照亮上方色域。松动层叠的笔触赋予云朵翻涌动势，让近处肌理带粗糙触感。远形被蓝色空气雾气压缩，少量锐利线条提供尺度和方向。构图以开阔深色区域和两处不等的光源制造视觉张力。整体效果戏剧化、异世界般而阴郁，色彩反差比精细细节更有力量。
theme_en: A blue coastal city and ship beneath storm clouds and firelight
theme_zh: 风暴云与火光下的蓝色海滨城市和船只
name: John Pitre
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
